body.name: Ordered private-guard expansion
body.construction: For each \(u\in U\), create \(x_u\) and add \(s\leftrightarrow x_u\). For each \(e=\{u,v\}\in E\) with \(u\prec v\), create a private \(z_e\) and add exactly \(x_u\to x_v\), \(x_v\to z_e\), \(z_e\to s\), and \(z_e\leftrightarrow x_u\). The resulting graph is \(G_H\).
